title: Reviewer Judgment Intents
description: Intent labels used by the reviewer judgment framework.

entries.title: Tentative Comment
entries.description: A cautious reviewer comment that does not yet become a finding.

entries.title: Request More Context
entries.description: The reviewer asks for more context before deciding.

entries.title: Confirmed Finding
entries.description: The reviewer can support a final finding.

entries.title: Narrative Justification
entries.description: The story context explains the outcome.

entries.title: Final Decision
entries.description: The reviewer concludes after weighing all support.
